summary: Fluidd is a lightweight web-based user interface designed specifically for the Klipper 3D printer firmware. It provides operators with a responsive control panel to monitor prints, manage configuration files, and send G-code commands directly to the printer. Built using Node.js and containerised with Docker, it runs as a companion service alongside your existing printer firmware stack.
goodFor: Makers and engineers running Klipper who want a clean, fast browser interface to manage their 3D printing workflows.
watchOut: It is tightly coupled to Klipper ecosystem components like Moonraker, so you will need to configure multiple dependent services rather than just a standalone application.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves running the Docker container behind a reverse proxy to handle web traffic, with persistent volumes configured for storing configuration files and logs.
